Chapter 08 / 11ARCHITECTURE

Give each specialist a bounded job.

A delegation contract defines the objective, scope, evidence requirements, output and stopping condition.

Example assignment

Find official token refresh documentation for API A. Exclude API B. Return claims with document URLs and sections, unknowns, and a short summary. Stop after covering the required flows or reaching the search budget.

Avoid duplicate work

Partition by source, domain or subquestion. Specify shared definitions and how results will merge. Use one agent for tightly coupled work when coordination costs outweigh parallelism.

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
